results.title: Unspoken Bond
results.overview: A feature documentary about a relationship often overlooked: the bond between humans and animals—not a substitute for human connection, but a profound one in its own right. Through three lives transformed by an animal, it reveals a bond that heals and connects us as deeply as any human relationship.

results.title: A Grief Encounter
results.overview: A taxidermist's unexpected attraction to a customer takes a twisted turn, forcing her to confront buried emotions about love and death in this darkly comedic Australian tale.

results.title: Eclipse
results.overview: In a near future, humanity has blotted out the sun with an artificial cloud in an attempt to stop climate collapse, and the world has lost its color. A photographer wanders this gray, lifeless landscape, obsessively searching for one last sign of life. When he meets a mysterious girl, he may finally have the chance to take the photograph he has been chasing all his life.

results.title: Divine Comedy
results.overview: Bahram, a censored director, embarks on a Vespa trip with producer Sadaf to clandestinely screen his film in Iran, challenging the system.

results.title: Just Call Me Frida
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Samuel is finally back home after a long illness. But instead of embracing life, he avoids anything that might be dangerous: germs, other kids and any kind of risk. Then Frida suddenly appears, the happiest and most curious little Grim Reaper in training ever. Of all people, cautious Samuel has been chosen to teach her what life is all about.

results.title: The Founder5 II: Unfinished Business
results.overview: Grander, bolder and sharper, the Founder5 returns to the stage with other talented comedians for more standup, improv and sketch comedy.

results.title: Behadd
results.overview: Behadd is a Gujarati Film about a girl who falls for a boy hiding his true identity. When her father learns the truth, he and his friend race to save her from lies. A gripping tale of love, faith, and betrayal in modern-day Gujarat.

results.title: RW-LO
results.overview: Martine Syms blends recreations with home movies from the life of Brent David Freaney, a lifelong pop girlie who was once, as vintage camcorder footage reveals, a Deep South teenager obsessed with outspoken The Real World: New Orleans castmate Melissa Howard. RW-LO is a nostalgic—and surprising—inquiry into what happens when people start being celebrities, and they stop being real.

results.title: Gush
results.overview: Elliot drags bestie Skylar along to her ex-girlfriend's Sálon. Seeking refuge from the boob-shaped discussion bowl in the bathroom; they get stuck in a tampon mishap stickier than the bad blood between old flames.

results.title: Still Life
results.overview: In an authoritarian dystopia where silence is law, Eris discovers a secret resistance keeping expression alive. But her brother, a relentless law enforcer, will stop at nothing to silence them - not even her.

results.title: Медные тревоги
results.overview: A jazz band rehearses in an old bar, creating unique musical abstractions. The arrival of a new saxophonist disrupts the band's usual routine.

results.title: Intermission
results.overview: Spanning nearly sixty years, Yonfan features his career in music, dance, photography, and writing through fifteen films in Intermission. This captivating cinematic journey stands as a witness to the essence of a changing world.

results.title: Rowe's Realm of Horror
results.overview: An outdoor haunt. A deadly after-hours secret. You're never alone.

results.title: Purity
results.overview: A boy is tired of Mexicans, so he kills one.

results.title: Amnesty 1979
results.overview: In Rome, in June 1979, the International Conference for Amnesty in Brazil is filmed, a major gathering of the Brazilian left in exile. Viewed in the present day, this archive revisits with rare vitality the question of political strategies in the face of state repressive apparatuses.

results.title: FC Barcelona: Dream, Play, Win
results.overview: A documentary that chronicles the transformation of the FC Barcelona women's team, from anonymity to the best team in the world. It's not just a sports story, but a tale of overcoming challenges, identity, culture, and female empowerment. Through three acts, it constructs an emotional journey through its players and their quest for glory in the UWCL finals.

results.title: From Dawn to Dawn
results.overview: A Wen, 38, a businessman and family man in Barcelona, is also the filmmaker's brother. Just like in the gangster movies they watched on VHS as kids, he becomes involved with the Chinese mafia in Spain.
